## History

While on their way back from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody), Shearer was approached by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) when they found a Jersey cow in Mr. Harrison's oat field. Believing the animal to be her own cow [Dolly](../character/dolly.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) impetuously sold the cow to Shearer on the spot.

_Sources: [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P12](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0012), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P24](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0024), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P28](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0028), [v2 II Selling in Haste and Repenting at Leisure P35](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0035)_
